title: Medicinal Herbs
description: A shaft of golden sunlight pierces the canopy, illuminating a patch of rare medicinal herbs. You recognize feverfew, comfrey, and what might be genuine witch hazel. Proper harvesting would yield valuable alchemical ingredients, but the clearing feels oddly still.

choices.label: Harvest carefully
choices.description: Take time to gather them properly.

outcomes.text: Your patience pays off. The herbs come free with roots intact — perfect for alchemical use.
You find an exceptionally vibrant cluster hidden beneath the feverfew. A rare find!
As you kneel to harvest, thorns hidden in the undergrowth scratch your hands deeply. You gather what you can through the pain.

choices.label: Grab everything quickly
choices.description: Rip up the whole patch before something finds you.

outcomes.text: You tear handfuls free in seconds. Quantity over quality, but it's a solid haul.
A venomous snake strikes from beneath the leaves! You stumble back, herbs scattering.
Your haste damages most of the roots, but you salvage a decent bundle.

choices.label: Leave them be
choices.description: The stillness unnerves you. Best to move on.

outcomes.text: You back away slowly. The clearing watches you go in silence.
